config.design: Decompose Attention5 local-value four-condition body-write interaction into all9 heads. Test single-head removal, full-minus-one-head removal, random matched per-position single-head norms. Choose subsets of size1/2/3/4 by exhaustive minimization of mean relative squared local-write error on old wording item0-3 only, freeze before downstream evaluation. Compare each mode with full local-interaction removal, not maximum target shrinkage.
config.scope: Adaptive on previously explored panel. Discovery eight endpoints; held-out same-wording eight and new-wording sixteen endpoints. New wording includes both familiar and different items. No fresh vocabulary or independent benchmark claim. Head subsets still require observed four-condition head interactions.
